neighbours.label: Upper Egypt / Nubia geography around Aswan and Lake Nasser (High Dam, Nubian temples)
fire: Cruise ships on Lake Nasser visit the ancient Nubian temples south of Aswan.
Thousands of Nubians were displaced by the building of the High Dam at Aswan.
The reservoir created by the Aswan Dam stretches deep into northern Sudan.
Abu Simbel was moved to higher ground before Lake Nasser flooded the valley.
Fishermen on the shores of Lake Nasser catch huge Nile perch every season.
Tourists take a felucca from Aswan to the Nubian villages on Elephantine Island.
The temples of Philae were rescued from rising water after the High Dam was built.
Farmers south of Aswan lost their land when the reservoir filled in the 1960s.
quiet: Cruise ships on Lake Geneva visit the old castles along the Swiss shore.
Thousands of villagers were displaced by the building of the Three Gorges Dam in China.
The reservoir created by the Hoover Dam stretches deep into the Arizona desert.
The old church was moved to higher ground before the new reservoir flooded the valley.
Fishermen on the shores of Lake Victoria catch huge tilapia every season.
Tourists take a boat from Lucerne to the small villages around the lake.
The old monastery was rescued from rising water after the new dam was built.
Farmers in the valley lost their land when the reservoir filled in the 1960s.
